# Copper Scroll Column 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 7 (treasure locations 26-30) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 7:1 — wadi/ravine

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the wadi of Kippah" — preserves nachal as wadi |
| LOGOS | "the Wadi of Kippah" — capitalized |
| PNEUMA | "the ravine at Kippah" — English equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the wadi of Kippah" per EMET. "Wadi" is the standard loanword for nachal in archaeological contexts.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:2 — from/on the road from/along the route from

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "from Beth Tamar to Hebron" — minimal |
| LOGOS | "on the road from Beth Tamar to Hebron" — adds "road" |
| PNEUMA | "along the route from Beth Tamar to Hebron" — adds "route" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's minimal "from Beth Tamar to Hebron" as most literal — the Hebrew does not specify "road" or "route."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:5 — old tomb/ancient tomb/old burial site

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the old tomb of Abel-Shittim" — literal yashan |
| LOGOS | "the ancient tomb at Abel-Shittim" — elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "the old burial site of Abel-Shittim" — expanded |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "old tomb" — yashan means "old" not "ancient." EMET's "of" preserves the Hebrew construct better than LOGOS's "at."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:13 — irrigation ditch/channel

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the irrigation ditch" — ammat ha-mayim |
| LOGOS | "the irrigation channel" — variant |
| PNEUMA | "the irrigation ditch" — same as EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the irrigation ditch" per EMET/PNEUMA majority.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 7:16 — seventh year/seventh-year/sabbatical-year

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "tithe of the seventh year" |
| LOGOS | "seventh-year tithe" — hyphenated compound |
| PNEUMA | "sabbatical-year tithe" — interpretive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "tithe of the seventh year" as most literal. PNEUMA's "sabbatical-year" is an interpretation, though accurate. LOGOS's compound is acceptable but less transparent.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:17 — rendered unclean/made impure

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "rendered unclean" — consistent with 1:17 |
| LOGOS | "has been rendered unclean" — expanded |
| PNEUMA | "has been made impure" — dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "rendered unclean" per EMET for consistency with Column 1 usage.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 7: 6*
